command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/numba
cd /tmp
printf '03c0a267424d4e7dbfca162ca4b6d35d9f06fa37164e30aac25a4ab85dd4e9aa  slideseq.h5ad\n600d54f849ca3d1e85f3d6816cb2ff2d7e52ece113d1ff33868154574fb5d70b  ties.py\n' > ties.sha256
sha256sum -c ties.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged file does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p out
uname -m > out/ties.txt
python3 -u ties.py >> out/ties.txt 2>&1; RC=$?
cat out/ties.txt
test "$RC" = 0 && grep -q '^TIES OK$' out/ties.txt || { echo FAIL; exit 1; }
